existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: AuditEvent has high-impact local breaking changes: outcome restructuring, mandatory agent identity, Coding-to-CodeableConcept classifiers, entity removals, entity.detail typing, and several R6 downgrade gaps. The main uncertainty is official mapping intent for outcome codes and removed fields.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Use an AuditEvent-specific transform: rename and reshape time/outcome fields, populate agent.who, wrap Coding as CodeableConcept, preserve removed agent/entity data through policy, and define R6-to-R4 downgrade extensions for new R6 fields.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural changes because both core StructureDefinitions are present and the R6 counterpart is unambiguous. Confidence is medium for terminology/semantic mapping because official expansions, ConceptMaps, and narrative change notes were unavailable.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
AuditEvent keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 9 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 5 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 100/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.entity.type, entity.lifecycle, and entity.name were removed
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 entity.type, entity.lifecycle, and entity.name are rejected by R6; lifecycle/type information can be lost unless profiles, extensions, or detail conventions are defined.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.outcome changed from primitive code to BackboneElement
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `outcome` as a primitive code and `outcomeDesc` are rejected by the R6 shape; R6 structured detail and issue-severity coding are lossy or judgment-dependent when downgraded to R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: purposeOfEvent and agent.purposeOfUse were renamed and broadened to authorization
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `purposeOfEvent` and `agent.purposeOfUse` are not R6 element names; R6 authorization values outside purpose-of-use are not cleanly representable in R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.entity.detail.type changed from string to CodeableConcept and detail values were broadened
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 detail.type strings fail the R6 CodeableConcept shape; new R6 typed values cannot be represented in R4 without stringifying or extensions.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Several optional agent fields were removed or reworked
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances populated with removed agent fields fail R6 validation; some values can be transformed, but media and network type require local preservation policy.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.source.site changed from string to Reference(Location), and source.observer target widened
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 `source.site` string is not the R6 Reference shape; R6 Location references and CareTeam observers need reduction or extension when downgraded to R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.period was replaced by occurred[x]
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 `period` property is not an R6 AuditEvent element; R6 `occurredDateTime` also creates limited R6-to-R4 loss unless converted to a Period or extension.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: AuditEvent.agent.who became mandatory while requestor became optional
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 agent without `who` fails R6 validation; R6 agents without explicit `requestor` or using newly allowed target types require defaults, reduction, or extensions for R4.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Several coded classifier elements changed Coding shape or weakened bindings
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: direct R4 Coding JSON is invalid for R6 CodeableConcept paths; R6 multiple codings/text cause R6-to-R4 loss unless one coding is selected and the rest preserved elsewhere.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: New optional R6 elements create R6-to-R4 representability gaps
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: populated R6 additions have no direct R4 slots, so a downgrade must drop, extension-preserve, or map them by local convention.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
